title: 7-Eleven Convenience Store
content: Interesting enough, I went inside a 7-Eleven that was surrounded by a nearby forest area. I was quite amazed that apparently it has its opening hours on the door. It was opened every day and its opening hours was from 7 AM to 11 PM. I went inside and apparently its popular item was their version of the slurpee. Instead of an iced drink, it was a cotton candy machine that contained a soda flavor that the slurpee usually has. Interesting thing about this is that this was my first time being inside a 7-Eleven in Mall World.
